caption: The drawing depicts a wooden doll with a carved brown head, neck, torso, arms, and hands. The facial features including eyes, nose, mouth, and eyebrows are defined with simple carved lines and shaded in a darker brown. The doll wears a dark gray or black fabric skirt that extends to just below the knees, and brown ankle-high lace-up boots that are also carved and shaded to suggest texture. The composition centers the doll on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or details present.
title: Doll
